page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor. It features 96 dedicated physical cores running at 2.5 GHz with a single thread per core configuration. The system is equipped with 372.0 GB of system memory, providing 3.88 GB per core. For acceleration, it bundles four NVIDIA Turing T4 GPUs with a combined VRAM of 64 GB. It does not include local storage and relies on network-attached storage, supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 30 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks reveal a clear contrast between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core CPU performance is weak, scoring 1103.89 in stress-ng tests, and single-threaded tasks like gzip compression and bzip3 decompression rank in the lower percentiles. Conversely, multi-core performance is strong, with stress-ng multi-core scoring 70574.45 and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaching 287.37 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient for small cached blocks at 3924.63 GB/sec, though large-block read and write speeds drop to average levels. Additionally, the instance demonstrates strong database capabilities, achieving 64.27 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers high resource density by combining a large physical core count with four dedicated GPUs, making it a viable option for parallelized workloads without the premium cost of newer-generation accelerators. Because it lacks local storage, workloads must be structured around network storage performance. This server is best suited for GPU-accelerated workloads such as machine learning inference, video transcoding, multi-threaded data processing, and high-throughput Redis database deployments.
